job.title: Retail assistant
job.description: Serving customers, fitting boots and packs, and receiving stock.

place: The Fitzroy store, 18 Example Street, Fitzroy VIC 3065
award: General Retail Industry Award 2020 (MA000004), Retail Employee Level 1

pay.method: electronic funds transfer to the employee's account

components.name: Casual loading
components.text: the hourly rate includes the 25 percent casual loading

hours.standard: as rostered, usually Saturday and Sunday, 9:00 to 17:00; each engagement is at least 3 hours

leave: Paid family and domestic violence leave, and unpaid carer's and compassionate leave, as the National Employment Standards provide
termination: Either side may end the employment; notice follows the award and the National Employment Standards
super: Superannuation guarantee contributions are paid into the employee's chosen fund, or the employer's default fund if none is chosen
